d.seg: ಇವಾಗ ವಿಡಿಯೋ ಕಾಲ್ ಗೆ 500 ಪೇ ಮಾಡಿ ಎಷ್ಟು ಹೊತ್ತು ಬೇಕು ಅಷ್ಟು ಹೊತ್ತು ಟೈಮ್ ಲಿಮಿಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲ ತೋರಿಸ್ತೀನಿ
d.tr: Now pay 500 for a video call and for as long as you want there is no time limit, I will show
d.ctx: The user offers to pay 500 for an unlimited video call where they will 'show', which violates the suspicious activity policy regarding payments tied to showing.
d.j: The user directly offers payment tied to showing and time, constituting a severe violation.
